_README: Gospel News Access ORIGINAL reporting. Starts empty on purpose.
We will not invent a story to demonstrate the feature. Every entry here
must be real reporting with a real dateline and a real timestamp.
- byline: a real reporter's name, or 'Gospel News Access Staff'.
- NEVER invent a person to put in the byline.
- A story about a named individual's conduct needs primary documentation
or an on-record source AND an attempt to reach them for comment.
If you have neither, the story does not run.
Set status to 'published' to make it live. Corrections print inline at
the bottom of the story, dated, and are also listed on /corrections.html.
